description: deployment_environment CI record (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record): installs this plugin alone (no dependencies; core's dimension model is the only type it writes) and seeds its pack, proving the bundle imports against a real grid. Offline, credential-free; the consumer flips self to editable.

plugins.note: Self, pinned at the bootstrap commit until the first tagged release; the consumer (plugin-ci, or `spawn --dev-plugins deployment_environment`) substitutes the checkout under test via tap.dev_workspace (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record-4).

steps.note: Own GRIFT: the dimension pack is the whole of what this plugin ships.
